recognize_zh: 中央右側淋巴球的細胞核深度分葉，呈花瓣或苜蓿葉狀（flower cell），染色質凝集、無明顯核仁；旁邊與左上另有核形不規則的異型淋巴球，為成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤（ATLL）的典型周邊血表現。
features: Medium-sized lymphocyte with a deeply multilobated, clover-leaf ('flower cell') nucleus
Condensed chromatin without conspicuous nucleoli; scant pale basophilic cytoplasm
Adjacent smaller lymphocyte with irregular, indented nucleus and small cytoplasmic projections
Larger atypical lymphoid cell at upper left with irregular nuclear contour and moderate pale cytoplasm
Background normocytic RBCs with mild poikilocytosis
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows atypical lymphoid cells, including a medium-sized cell with a deeply multilobated, petal-like 'flower' nucleus, condensed chromatin, no visible nucleolus and scant basophilic cytoplasm. An adjacent smaller lymphocyte and a larger cell at the upper left also show irregular nuclear contours. Red cells show mild poikilocytosis. The flower-cell morphology is characteristic of adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD4+, CD25+, CD7-) and HTLV-1 serology is recommended.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells have cerebriform, finely grooved nuclei rather than discrete petal-like lobes and lack HTLV-1.
T-PLL cells have round or mildly irregular nuclei with a visible nucleolus and blebbed basophilic cytoplasm.
Neutrophils have pink granular cytoplasm and lobes connected by thin filaments rather than clustered lobes in agranular cytoplasm.
Reactive cells show only mild indentation, abundant cytoplasm and a polyclonal heterogeneous population.
